pr_title: Implement semantic DeepEqual for ResourceList and EmptyDirVolumeSource
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
As #82242 mentioned, ResourceList and EmptyDirVolumeSource involve Quantity field, hence their semantic DeepEqual should use Cmp between Quantity fields.

This PR adds ResourceList and EmptyDirVolumeSource to semantic.go

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #82242

```release-note
NONE
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

```docs

```

issue_context.title: resource.Quantity.String() destroys reflect.DeepEqual()
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:

```
	q := resource.MustParse("512Mi")
	p1 := &corev1.Pod{
		Spec: corev1.PodSpec{
			Volumes: []corev1.Volume{
				{
					VolumeSource: corev1.VolumeSource{
						EmptyDir: &corev1.EmptyDirVolumeSource{
							SizeLimit: &q,
						},
					},
				},
			},
		},
	}

	p2 := p1.DeepCopy()
	fmt.Println(reflect.DeepEqual(p1, p2))    // ture
	fmt.Print(p1)
	fmt.Println(reflect.DeepEqual(p1, p2))    // false
```

The result is caused by resource.Quantity.String():
```
// String formats the Quantity as a string, caching the result if not calculated.
// String is an expensive operation and caching this result significantly reduces the cost of
// normal parse / marshal operations on Quantity.
func (q *Quantity) String() string {
	if len(q.s) == 0 {
		result := make([]byte, 0, int64QuantityExpectedBytes)
		number, suffix := q.CanonicalizeBytes(result)
		number = append(number, suffix...)
		q.s = string(number)
	}
	return q.s
}
```

**What you expected to happen**:

Quantity should not change in a `Get` method.

I think we could simply remove the field `s`, since It just takes a little overhead.
comments: /sig api-machinery

/assign @kdada 
I see you are trying to fix the issue you reported.

The field s is for speeding up String operation. I don't think it should be removed.

For the test case above, I think it is up to the creator of Quantity to fill the field s - we can provide helper func which creates Quantity and fills the field s.
Another approach is to create a helper func wrapping reflect.DeepEqual where we first call String() on Quantity's involved in the comparison.

/remove-kind bug

consider use `k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/equality.Semantic#DeepEqual`

```

```
Here is test code:
```
	q := MustParse("512Mi")
	q.String()
	q1 := MustParse("512Mi")
	if !apiequality.Semantic.DeepEqual(q, q1) {
		t.Errorf("not equal %v %v", q, q1)
	}
```

There are plenty of objects with hidden state in Kube which are not DeepEqual due to side effects.

I don't consider this a bug.

Why do we need to do that?

What do you think of the error shown in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/82242#issuecomment-527517315 ?

@smarterclayton I don't think it's a bug. I consider that it's a convention problem.

`resource.Quantity` changes itself by the `String()` which is a `GET` method. `resource.Quantity.String()` only affects itself when the receiver is a pointer. That means it may have two behaviors in an object. 

ex. corev1.Pod:
```
type ResourceList map[ResourceName]resource.Quantity

type EmptyDirVolumeSource struct {
	SizeLimit *resource.Quantity
}
``` 

1. Marshaling `corev1.Pod` won't change anything.
2. `fmt.Print(corev1.Pod)` changes `EmptyDirVolumeSource.SizeLimit` but have no effect to ResourceList.

> Here is test code:

?
/assign @smarterclayton

Using the Semantic.DeepEqual is the right solution here. In fact, resource.Quantity is explicitly handled there, see [code](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/836b901658557ee18936d3690dc9c48fc588eba8/staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/equality/semantic.go#L30).

The failure in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/82242#issuecomment-527517315 was caused by the "staging/src -> vendor" symlink in the k8s repo.

From the root of the k8s/k8s, if I ran the following commands, I can reproduce the error in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/82242#issuecomment-527517315:
```
cd staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/resource/mytest
go test -run <TestName>
```

If instead I `cd` into the vendor folder, the test passed, i.e., 
```
cd vendor/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/resource/mytest
go test -run <TestName>
```

review_comments: This will add a dependency to k8s.io/api from k8s.io/apimachinery, which would be cyclical, since k8s.io/api already depends on k8s.io/apimachinery

If you need an equality semantic which understands things in k8s.io/api/core/v1, it either has to live in core/v1, live somewhere else, or you have to move those parts of k8s.io/api/core/v1 to k8s.io/apimachinery
